plain: Turned aside from its path or use and sent somewhere else

webster.text: Turned aside; turned or drawn from any course, or from the usual or intended direction; pleased; amused; entertained.

example.quote: We ought, therefore, to be exceedingly cautious about diverting or restraining it.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
